about: e100 (coordinator ruling 2026-11-26): a member's Pine-script ALERT and the single-symbol strategy BACKTEST run on the chart's history. A daily runtime alert fetches up to the runtime's history limit and runs every bar with historyFromListing true ONLY when bar 0 is the symbol's FINAL first-trade day (listing_history, the chart's listingSeed.js rule ported; one parity fixture both hosts read); otherwise the curtain (the last 5,000 bars, false), byte-for-byte as before. The backtest takes the chart's ctx (12,500-bar strategy window, 5,000 served depth, true) on the same condition and its old job otherwise; the broker's [B-START-DEEP] is untouched. Sweeps, scans, the screener backtest and the definition record stay at 5,000, off the listing. Each mutant must turn its rail red and restore byte-equal.
